metadata.name: terp
metadata.description: Token-2022 transfer-tax launchpad whose tax funds Phoenix perp positions, with burn-to-redeem

accounts.name: treasury_usdc
docs: The platform treasury's USDC account, for the keeper fee.

accounts.name: market
docs: The Phoenix perp market this launch's tax will be levered into.

accounts.name: claim
docs: Holds what is still owed if Phoenix queues the withdrawal; closed again otherwise.

types.name: Claim
docs: USDC owed to a redeemer whose tokens are already burned. Created only when Phoenix queued the
withdrawal that would have paid them; the amount is fixed and paid as soon as USDC arrives.

fields.name: total_supply
docs: Must equal the mint's supply; nothing can be minted afterwards.

fields.name: creator_allocation
docs: Disclosed split of the supply. Informational, checked to add up; actual balances are
public on-chain.

fields.name: initial_price
docs: The pool's starting price, USDC atoms per token atom scaled by 1e12. It seeds the
reference price that tax conversions are checked against.

fields.name: min_convert_tokens
docs: Tax batches below this are not converted.

fields.name: max_convert_tokens
docs: Largest tax batch sold in one conversion.

fields.name: max_price_drop_bps
docs: How far below the reference price one conversion may execute, per cooldown elapsed.

fields.name: min_deposit_usdc
docs: USDC batches below this are not deposited as collateral.

fields.name: deposited
docs: USDC deposited as Phoenix collateral.

fields.name: leverage_bps_before
docs: Leverage once the deposit was in, before any order.

fields.name: unrealized_pnl
docs: The position's unrealized PnL when the call ran.

fields.name: increased
docs: True when exposure was added: there was no position, or leverage was under the minimum.

types.name: Launch
docs: One launch: the tax vault of one token. It is the mint's only withdraw-withheld authority,
the owner of every vault asset, and the authority of the launch's own Phoenix trader account,
which is what isolates launches from each other.

fields.name: pool
docs: Liquidity pool the tax is sold into. Set once by the creator.

fields.name: tax_usdc
docs: USDC account of the tax authority: swaps pay out here and the program forwards on.

fields.name: trader_account
docs: Zero until `register_trader`.

fields.name: transfer_fee_bps
docs: The mint's transfer tax, 1% or 3%, as verified on the mint at creation.

fields.name: min_leverage_bps
docs: Under this a deployment buys exposure back up to target.

fields.name: deleverage_to_bps
docs: What a deleverage above the maximum reduces leverage to.

fields.name: keeper_fee_bps
docs: Share of converted tax the platform takes for running the keeper.

fields.name: pending_claims
docs: USDC owed to redeemers whose Phoenix withdrawal was queued. Senior to equity.

fields.name: usdc_converted
docs: What reached the vault: pool proceeds less the keeper fee.

types.name: Market
docs: A Phoenix perp market a launch can pick as its leveraged asset. Listed by the admin, never
edited afterwards: a launch copies these values at creation and keeps them for good.

fields.name: tick_size
docs: Quote lots (USDC atoms) per base lot, per price tick.

fields.name: base_lot_decimals
docs: One base lot is `10^-base_lot_decimals` of the asset. Display only.

fields.name: symbol
docs: ASCII ticker, zero-padded. Display only.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Protocol-wide settings. The admin can rotate itself, the keeper and the treasury, list perp
markets launches may choose from, and pause risk-increasing actions. Neither the admin nor
the keeper has a path to any launch's tokens, USDC, collateral or position.

fields.name: keeper
docs: The launchpad operator's key: the only one that may convert tax and deploy it. It decides
when; the program decides how much, at what price, and where the money goes.

fields.name: treasury
docs: The platform's wallet: receives the keeper fee, and residual USDC of a launch whose supply
reached zero.

fields.name: keeper_fee_bps
docs: Share of converted tax paid to the treasury, applied to launches created from now on.
A launch keeps the rate it was created with.

fields.name: swap_program
docs: AMM the tax is sold through (Meteora DLMM on mainnet). Immutable.

fields.name: swap_discriminators
docs: Instruction discriminators of `swap_program` a conversion may call. Immutable.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks launch creation, tax conversion and deployment. Never blocks deleveraging,
redemptions or claim payouts.

fields.name: supply_before
docs: `S` before the burn

fields.name: equity
docs: `E` at redemption, net of claims

fields.name: paid
docs: Paid in this transaction.

fields.name: owed
docs: Recorded as a claim because Phoenix queued the withdrawal.

fields.name: usdc_out
docs: What the pool paid.

fields.name: keeper_fee
docs: The platform's keeper fee, paid to the treasury; the rest went to the vault.

fields.name: price
docs: USDC atoms per token atom, scaled by 1e12.

fields.name: keeper_fee_bps
docs: For launches created afterwards; existing launches keep their rate.
